questions.question:
**Directions: Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. This flight takes place on a hot summer day.

B. It has a pair of wings but bites them off after its ‘wedding’ flight.

C. In the heat, the queen leaves the nest and goes out to meet a drone, high up in the air.

D. The queen is the mother of the entire population of a colony of ants.
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'DBAC'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence 'D' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "the queen of ants". Hence, 'D' is the first part. • Sentence B will come after D because it explains what the queen of ants does with the pair of wings. • Sentence A will come after B because it explains when the wedding flight takes place. • The sentence 'C' is the concluding part because it mentions what the queen of ants does in the heat. Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *The queen is the mother of the entire population of a colony of ants. It has a pair of wings but bites them off after its ‘wedding’ flight. This flight takes place on a hot summer day. In the heat, the queen leaves the nest and goes out to meet a drone, high up in the air*. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__*** __ • Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__: __ • Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options. • Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence). • Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • वाक्य 'D' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "चींटियों की रानी" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'D' पहला भाग है। • वाक्य B, D आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि चींटियों की रानी पंखों की जोड़ी के साथ क्या करती है। • वाक्य A, B के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि शादी की उड़ान कब होगी। • वाक्य 'C' समापन भाग है क्योंकि इसमें उल्लेख है कि चींटियों की रानी गर्मी में क्या करती है। 2f:T14df, The correct answer is 'had been auctioned'.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

The house __has been auction__ before we reached there.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'had been auctioned'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the use of the base or root form of the verb ''auction'' is incorrect.
 
• The given sentence is in the past perfect passive tense, it is used **to talk about actions that were completed before some point in the past**.
 
• The past perfect passive tense format is: **Object + had + been + V3 (past participle)**.
 
• Therefore, the past participle form of the verb ''auctioned'' should be used in place of the base or root form of the verb ''auction''.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct Sentence: *The house **had been auctioned** before we reached there*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• रेखांकित खंड में 'auction' verb के base or root form का प्रयोग गलत है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य past perfect passive tense में है, इसका उपयोग **उन कार्यों के बारे में बात करने के लिए किया जाता है जो अतीत में किसी बिंदु से पहले पूरे हुए थे**।
 
• Past perfect passive tense फॉर्मेट है: Object + had + been + V3 (past participle)।
 
• इसलिए, past participle form of the verb ''auctioned'' का प्रयोग base or root form of the verb ''auction'' के स्थान पर किया जाना चाहिए।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है ।

सही वाक्य: *The house had been auctioned before we reached there*.

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the given sentence, the use of the past tense form of the verb ''submitted'' is incorrect. • **'Did'** is an **auxiliary verb** or **helping verb** that is **followed by the main verb**. • The **auxiliary verb (did)** is marked for **past tense**, but the **main verb is not, it appears in its base form**. • When there is an auxiliary verb, the **main verb does not need to be marked for tense**, because **the tense is shown in the auxiliary**. • The **verb that follows** **'did'** should be used **in its base or root form**. • Therefore, the base or root form of the verb ''submit'' should be used in place of the past tense form of the verb ''submitted''. Hence, the correct answer is option 4. Correct Sentence: *Why didn’t **you submit** your project on time?* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • दिए गए वाक्य में 'submitted' verb के past tense form का प्रयोग गलत है। • **'Did'** एक auxiliary verb or helping verb है जिसके बाद main verb होती है। • Auxiliary verb (did), past tense के लिए सक्रिय है, लेकिन main verb नहीं है, यह अपने base form में प्रकट होती है। • जब एक auxiliary verb होती है, तो main verb को tense के लिए चिह्नित करने की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है, क्योंकि tense को auxiliary में दिखाया जाता है। • 'Did' के बाद आने वाली verb को उसके base or root form में प्रयोग करना चाहिए। • इसलिए, base or root form of the verb ''submit'' का प्रयोग past tense form of the verb ''submitted'' के स्थान पर किया जाना चाहिए। अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है । सही वाक्य: *Why didn’t **you submit** your project on time?* 34:T109c, The correct answer is 'extend.'

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action. • In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence. • The given sentence is in active voice and it is in the present perfect tense. • When we convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject 'The prisoners of this jail' of the active voice becomes the object, the object 'these carpets' becomes the subject. • The active format "have + V3 (woven)" should be converted into the passive format "have/has + been + V3 (woven)". • This is the active and passive voice rule for the present perfect tense. Hence, the correct answer is option 3. questions.question:
**Directions: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

The gardener said to the children, “Please do not pluck any flowers.”

options.text: The gardener told to the children to kindly not pluck any flowers.
The gardener requested the children not to pluck any flowers
The gardener ordered the children to not pluck any flowers
The gardener requested to the children please do not pluck any flowers

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The gardener requested the children not to pluck any flowers**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The commas, inverted commas are removed.
 
• 'Please' indicates a request and therefore, 'requested' should be used in place of 'please'.
 
• ''Don't'' should be replaced by ''not to''.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य direct speech है।
 
• Direct speech को indirect speech में बदलने या बदलने के लिए बुनियादी नियम:
 
 
• Commas, inverted commas और exclamation mark हटा दिए जाते हैं।
 
• 'Please' एक अनुरोध को इंगित करता है और इसलिए, 'Please' के स्थान पर 'requested' का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• ''Don't' को ''not to'' से बदल देना चाहिए।

 
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य "*...flamingoes abandoned ___(5)___ low-lying breeding areas, and zoo animals rushed into their shelters*'' जानवरों को उनके आश्रयों में भाग लेने का संकेत दे रहा है।
 
• वाक्य में plural noun ''flamingoes'' का प्रयोग pronoun 'their' के उपयोग को इंगित करता है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'their' है।
 
• शब्द 'their' का अर्थ है **उनका (उनसे संबंधित या उनके स्‍वामित्‍व वाला)**। 
 
 
• उदाहरण: *Men too seldom see their own faults*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *...flamingoes abandoned their low-lying breeding areas, and zoo animals rushed into their shelters*.
